_comment: Edit this file to match your actual building. 'rotationStart' should be a Monday — it's the anchor date the rotation counts from, so changing it shifts every future assignment. Rooms are listed floor by floor; the rotation cycles through them in the order they appear here (Floor 1 top to bottom, then Floor 2, then Floor 3), one room per weekday, then repeats. Optionally set 'rotationOrder' to an explicit array of room IDs to control the cycle order yourself instead of relying on the floor order.
